Our Story

Crafted with
Passion

Born in the vibrant heart of Erbil, Rwad Cafe is more than a coffee shop — it\'s a destination. Nestled inside Tablo Mall on Kirkuk Road, we\'ve created a space where time slows down, conversations flow, and every drink is a carefully crafted experience.

From the first espresso pull of dawn to the last latte of midnight, our doors are always open. Because great coffee and good company have no closing time.
